text:
maya: Quick sync — planning rollout for the routing+opt-in feature. Need input on deployment economics, cohort gating, and fallback triggers. Thinking staged regions + tenant opt-ins + cost caps.

alex: Can you share the target SLOs and cost constraints so we can align on flags?

maya: Targets: hosted 99p latency <250ms, dedicated 99p <150ms. Cost guard: avoid >1.5x current per-token for free/self-serve tiers. Enterprise can have higher spend but must trigger alerts. :money_with_wings:

sam: For cohorts propose: pilot (10 tenants, manual rollback), early (100 tenants, auto-rollback on error signals). Flag config should support allowlist + percent rollout + region overrides. Example rule idea:
```
flag: routing_v2
rules:
  - allowlist: [tenant-42, tenant-78]
  - pct: 10
  - pct: 50 when region in ['eu','na']
```
toni: Add economics-driven fallback: if estimated per-request cost > tenant_cap OR gpu_queue_util > 80% then route to cheaper model variant + emit telemetry and billing tag. Also add a temporary token-rate throttle option.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary window 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC. Autocutoff: 5% increase in 5xxs or 15m sustained error delta.

alex: How do we compute estimated cost per request at routing time? runtime token prediction + cost table?

sam: Yes — runtime estimator + model_cost_map. We'll expose /v1/cost_est and attach cost_score to route decision. Also keep per-tenant monthly spending guardrails and pre-approve limits for enterprise. See internal RFC: https://go/internal/routing-econ (proto).

maya: Action items: 1) Sam — prototype flag DSL + cost estimator end of week. 2) Toni — fallback dial + SLO playbook + throttle knobs. 3) Alex — assemble top 20 high-throughput tenants for pilot invites and check compliance. I'll schedule shiproom and invite infra.

alex: :thumbsup: I'll pull the list and DM legal for opt-in terms.

toni: Also propose a 48h shadow run in NA before any traffic flip — collect cost deltas and latency differences, no customer impact.

maya: Great. If no objections, lock plan Friday and create canary run. Ping here when prototypes land.
